deviation: directive threshold not met on the published corpus: 149 concepts form 46 equivalence classes under the 17 questions (win-rate capped at 0.3087 for ANY policy; both policies end in the same terminal state with the same min(H) fallback guess, so the win-rate clause is a null hypothesis at equal sample size), and questions-to-solve is dominated by class-min wins decidable only after all 17 questions (both medians equal).
